extension.summary: Keeps the TV guide on the current time
extension.description: Kodi leaves the TV guide where you left it, so after a night with the TV off it still shows yesterday. This service re-opens the guide on the current time when the guide is open, nothing is playing and there was no input for a configurable number of minutes (default 10, range 1-1440). When a screensaver is active the guide is refreshed as soon as the screensaver ends.
